correctness.rationale: For every nontrivial conference graph with v=5 mod 8, the SRG parameter identity gives A²=A+I+J, and vectors u=Ae and w=1+e are independent, even-weight and orthogonal. Direct expansion proves N=B³+I=wwᵀ+uuᵀ, rank N=2, N²=0, hence B⁶=I. On span(w,u), B has minimal polynomial t²+t+1. Fixed points of B are span(1+u), and a B²-fixed state must be B-fixed because B+I is invertible on im N. Consequently dimensions of Fix(B), Fix(B²), Fix(B³), Fix(B⁶) are 1,1,v−2,v and cycle populations follow. The baseline decomposition span(1)⊕ker 1ᵀ proves the exact one-step transient census. Matrix tests at v=5,13,29,37,53,61,101 and full enumeration at v=5,13 were replayed from included scripts. Finite computations do not prove all v or extension fields; algebra does.

value.rationale: A motivated feedback-sensitivity problem on canonical conference strongly regular networks is answered uniformly across an infinite family and all characteristic-two field extensions. One self-feedback site makes an originally noninvertible linear update globally reversible and creates exact six-period cycles; the rank-two square-zero perturbation mechanism yields full primitive orbit populations. This is a structural dynamical transition rather than a merely reparameterized code-rank observation or isolated small-graph table.
